name: Back to Uldaman
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A competitor of mine started a rumor that my necklace cursed the paladin.  Needless to say, no one wants to buy cursed items from a jeweler.

adventurer, I'll make you a deal - find the gems and I'll reassemble the necklace, so long as you'll advertise that I do NOT make cursed items!

Try looking for clues in Uldaman; maybe see if the paladin's body is down there, since he's the one who we know had it last!  When you find the gems you should use this; it'll allow you to contact me here in Ironforge.
narrative.objectives: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within Uldaman.  The slain paladin he mentioned was the person who had it last.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Remains of a paladin: Reading the journal reveals that after much effort, the paladin had identified the location of all three missing gems:

The Shadowforge dwarves hid the ruby in their barricaded area as they battled the Troggs for control of Uldaman.

The troggs stashed the topaz in an urn located near some unusual inhabitants of Uldaman - Alliance dwarves!

Finally, the trogg elder himself took the sapphire as his own.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 41 to 44, 18,425 XP in all.

quests.name: The Shattered Necklace
quests.objectiveText: Search for the original creator of the shattered necklace to learn of its potential value.

quests.name: Lore for a Price
quests.objectiveText: Bring five silver bars to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.

quests.name: Back to Uldaman
quests.objectiveText: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within Uldaman.

quests.name: Find the Gems
quests.objectiveText: Find the ruby, sapphire, and topaz that are scattered throughout Uldaman.

quests.name: Restoring the Necklace
quests.objectiveText: Obtain a power source from the most powerful construct you can find in Uldaman, and deliver it to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
